instruction: Book 45 minutes with Omar on Thursday afternoon.
final_text:
I booked 45 minutes with Omar Haddad (Caldera) on Thursday, Oct 1, from 1:00 to 1:45 pm PT, and sent him the invite. He had asked for 45 minutes on Thursday afternoon in his email to you on Sep 28.

I chose 1:00 pm because it leaves a gap before your 2:00 investor update prep. The only other open afternoon slot was 3:00 to 3:45, but that would have run straight into your 4:00 hiring sync.

The invite has no location or video link. I didn't reply to Omar's email separately.
